_doc: Constants of the flow table (tab:flows). router: flits p = ceil((header_bytes + payload rounded up to a multiple of 4) / flit_bytes), with the 12-byte noc_packet_t header (pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/include/lib/noc.h), the rounding of ucx_noc_create_packet (lib/noc.c) and 32-bit flits of the DDMA (device/ddma.c); zero-load latency L0 = cycles_per_hop (m + 1) + p + extra_cycles of the Hermes router. deadline_phase: the deadline of a flow falls in the phase after the phase of its source.
